- **#4409 and #4412** (Moss's "Central handoffs next week" digest, Jan 2 2026): #4409 is a report that keeps timing out at the Salina North yard, and #4412 is a glitch in the text prompts sent to drivers. The digest puts both on "Pree's dealer account," right after it says Marrow Fieldworks changes hands on Jan 5. It never names Marrow Fieldworks for them, so I told Pree I'm assuming that's the account.
- **#8841** (#central-random, Tobias, Oct 13), possibly related: a door that double-books when trucks check in early. Tobias filed it under "Tobias's dealer account," and nothing ties it to Marrow Fieldworks. I listed it only in case the account moved to him in the January handoff.

I left out PD-4821 and FR-882 because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. I couldn't tell what "this week's chat" meant, so I checked this week's messages in every channel Pree belongs to and in our DM. None had more Marrow Fieldworks tickets. Moss has no personal notes folder that I can see; the notes I used are the digests Moss wrote in the team folders. I also can't see any account ticket folders, so the list only covers notes and chat.
